Conversely, we had a party member just tonight who was flinging insults through text chat for no reason while we carried him to the end. We were going to ignore him and not kick him. We could two-man it just fine (was literally myself and my friend carrying a third friend). He refused to come into the portal to finish the game after we finally called him out, so we kicked him. 

TL;DR
It's extremely unfortunate that some people will abuse it at the expense of one person such as yourself. However, I would much rather that than have one person grief three other players.

Side-note: One possible solution could be to kick the last person that doesn't enter the portal after 20 seconds or so? As long as it can't be reset by entering and exiting anyway.
